scope: Offline ordinary-FFF geometry and material-multiplier comparison, not printer commissioning
sample_material_context: OEM PETG, then a copied offline-only material and process group
limitations: Only the zero-labelled sample was natively imported and sliced for this comparison; all19 models passed independent geometry checks.
The native sample uses installed OEM PETG ordinary-FFF settings, not accepted PCTG values or replacement-machine tooling proof.
Do not transfer T1/E routing or OEM parameter values to another tool, unit, mode or version without its own output check.
The comparison excludes E-only retraction recovery from deposited-filament totals; counting every positive E would misstate the result.
Raw exports contain session metadata and remain private; no ready-to-run G-code is distributed.
